text: The art exhibition's theme revolves around urban life and its relentless pace. To complement the visual art pieces, a playlist with hip-hop tracks will play in the background, incorporating the genre's characteristic beats and lyrical flow to echo the energetic and often gritty atmosphere of city living. The rhythmic cadence of the verses mirrors the staccato rhythm of traffic and footsteps, while the raw, unfiltered narratives of the lyrics reflect the complex social tapestry of the metropolis. This auditory layer deepens the viewer's immersion, transforming the gallery space into a dynamic soundscape that pulses with the same vitality and tension found in the streets outside.
